description: This file defines the page component and related functions for rendering individual blog posts based on dynamic slugs in a Next.js application. It includes data fetching functions, metadata generation, and the page component itself.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Fetches a post by slug from the backend API.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters for pre-rendering post pages.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Creates metadata for SEO purposes based on the post data.
